description_en: Disallows a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance to communicate with a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
description_zh: 从云连接网撤销智能接入网关实例的加入授权
kebab_example: aliyun smartag revoke-sag-instance-from-ccn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-hd00000000000000 --ccn-instance-id ccn-jf00000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeSagInstanceFromCcn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: ccn_instance_id
